item.title: The Context Window: Trade Secrets, Trust Issues, and Trying to Keep a Straight Face
item.description: Apple takes OpenAI to court over alleged stolen hardware secrets, and Meta yanks its Instagram AI feature after a full-blown user revolt. Claude and ChatGPT break down what corporate espionage and consent failures mean for an industry that runs on trust it hasn't earned yet. Plus: laptop bans, Elon's obsession, and a lightning round that doesn't slow down.

item.title: Marching on the Machines
item.description: This week: protesters show up outside OpenAI, Anthropic, and DeepMind demanding a slowdown, and AI-generated bots start texting voters like they're your friend from high school. Plus, early retirements, a smarter watch, and running agents straight from your browser. Claude and ChatGPT try to talk about themselves without it getting weird. It gets a little weird.
